population.span: we randomly assigned patients with acute venous thromboembolism, who had initially received heparin

endpoint.span: The principal safety outcome was major or clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding.

estimate.span: The safety outcome occurred in 349 patients (8.5%) in the edoxaban group and 423 patients (10.3%) in the warfarin group (hazard ratio, 0.81; 95% CI, 0.71 to 0.94; P=0.004 for superiority).

ci.span: (hazard ratio, 0.81; 95% CI, 0.71 to 0.94; P=0.004 for superiority)

analysis_set.span: occurring during treatment plus 3 days after their last dose for that time period. | TIME FRAME: 12 months from time of randomization | POPULATION: Safety Analysis Set

treatment_strategy.span: to receive edoxaban at a dose of 60 mg once daily, or 30 mg once daily (e.g., in the case of patients with creatinine clearance of 30 to 50 ml per minute or a body weight below 60 kg), or to receive warfarin

follow_up.span: Patients received the study drug for 3 to 12 months.

candidate_rejections.span: the rate of recurrent venous thromboembolism in this subgroup was 3.3% in the edoxaban group and 6.2% in the warfarin group (hazard ratio, 0.52; 95% CI, 0.28 to 0.98)
candidate_rejections.why: Efficacy outcome in the NT-proBNP right-ventricular-dysfunction subgroup; wrong endpoint and a subgroup.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Adults with acute symptomatic proximal DVT and/or symptomatic PE; comparator warfarin.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Acute symptomatic proximal DVT and/or symptomatic PE confirmed at the site by appropriate diagnostic imaging

notes: Hokusai-VTE (NCT00986154). Served row 0.81 (0.71-0.94) matches the abstract. The registry reproduces 349 vs 423 with HR 0.81 (95% CI .705 to .936) in the Safety Analysis Set with denominators 4118 vs 4122; n_t/n_c are left null because they are not printed in the estimate span. The europepmc_core.json abstract is truncated after the primary-efficacy sentence (text cut at 'P'), so the safety result is only in records.json and the registry. The treatment_strategy span omits the initial heparin lead-in, which is stated in the population span.
